name: av_forex_daily
description:
Historical daily (latest 100 days) exchange-rate bars for one currency pair from Alpha Vantage (FX_DAILY).
Returns: {"Meta Data", "Time Series FX (Daily)"} keyed by date, each with "1. open" to "4. close" (no volume).
Inputs (* required): from (ISO currency code; default EUR); to (ISO currency code; default USD).
Related: av_forex_weekly for weekly bars, av_forex_rate for the current rate; other sources: yf_forex_history, openbb_forex_historical.
Example: {"from": "EUR", "to": "USD"}
